title: Silk Road Motors stand at UzAutoShow 2023
description: Two-story stand with panoramic glazing and an interactive zone. Primary color — matte black with gold accents. Included meeting rooms on the upper level, presentation areas, and an automotive podium.

title: UzFarm modular stand at AgriExpo
description: Mobile modular stand for participation in multiple exhibitions over the season. Lightweight aluminum profile construction with reconfiguration options.

title: Conference space at IT Forum 2023
description: Full organization of a 150-seat conference hall with branding, navigation, and technical fit-out. Included a stage, media wall, and networking zone.

title: TashkentMed international stand at Medica
description: Stand for participation in the world's largest medical exhibition. Prefabricated stand with full logistics support from Tashkent to Düsseldorf.

title: Agromir stand at AgroCentral 2022
description: Stand with live plants and demonstration zones. Natural materials, eco-friendly concept, open layout for maximum visitor flow.

title: AlmazPharm stand at PharmExpo
description: Stand with clinical aesthetics: white gloss, lighting, and display cases for pharmaceutical products. Participation in Almaty with full logistics support.

title: Alif Bank modular stand
description: Fintech bank stand with interactive screens and consultation zone. Corporate brand colors, modern tech-forward look.

title: BuildUz 2023 congress zone
description: Main congress zone organization for the construction exhibition: registration desk, navigation, stage with media backdrop, photo zones, and networking space.

title: MaxWay stand at FoodExpo
description: Stand with a tasting zone and open kitchen. Vibrant brand design, high visitor traffic.

title: UzTextile stand at ITMA Asia
description: Presentation of the Uzbek textile industry at Asia's largest textile exhibition. National motifs in a contemporary interpretation.

title: Perfectum transformable stand
description: Compact tech-forward stand with touchscreen display cases for showcasing mobile devices and accessories.

title: Uzbekistan Tourism pavilion at WTM
description: Uzbekistan's national tourism pavilion at the world's largest travel exhibition. Immersive design with architectural elements of Samarkand and Bukhara.
